title: Brazilian-Style Roast Beef
description: A flavorful and tender roast beef dish with a hint of Brazilian spices, served gluten-free.
instructions: Season the roast with salt, black pepper, cumin, and paprika.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the roast until browned on all sides.
Remove the roast from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it's softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth, coffee, and brown sugar to the pot, scraping up any browned bits.
Return the roast to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and roast for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until the roast reaches an internal temperature of 135°F (57°C) for medium-rare.
Remove the roast from the pot and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve with the juices from the pot spooned over the top.
